prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Create Your Custom Pet Photo", "Upload 1-3 clear photos of your pet. Make sure lighting is bright and face is well-framed."]
1: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Your pet is now active. Complete a quick 10-second tray control practice to learn how to manage them.", "Practice Tray & Visibility Controls", "Click the system tray icon below to test hiding and revealing your pet on your screen.", "Click System Tray Icon to Hide/Show", "Finish Onboarding"]
2: ["Recommended Choice For You", "Based on your quiz answers, we recommend instant adoption or custom photo generation.", "What Kind of Desktop Pet Do You Want?", "Answer two quick questions to find your ideal companion path.", "Do you want to upload real photos or pick a ready pet?"]
3: ["Link Your Pet to Your Account", "Sign in now so your adopted pet is permanently saved to the cloud before setup finishes."]
4: ["Save & Restore Your Desktop Pet", "Sign in with your email or social account to back up your pet state and prevent data loss across restarts.", "Secure Pet Backup & Continue"]
5: ["Preparing Your Desktop Workspace", "Checking multi-monitor support, overlay permissions, and graphics acceleration...", "Checking GPU Hardware Acceleration & Tray Integration"]
6: ["Select Your Companion", "Every adoption includes a free exclusive starter hat item!", "Bonus Gift: Golden Crown Accessory Included!"]
7: ["Shortcut: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to instantly bring your desktop pet to the front or open controls."]
8: []
9: ["Meet Your Future Desktop Buddy", "Scroll down to see what desktop pets can do on your screen before creating yours!"]
